This has been done in the form of our genesis NFT's

This has been done - but were still looking to commision a few more pieces before launch
- Build out framework for editorial content around the featured artist community. 


This has had a lot of development throughout last year - and will are commissioning some more writers to input here also.  We have some very cool interviews of the featured artists 

- Create awareness for New-Futures through community collaboration and strategic partnerships. Collective ecosystem growth Onboard waitlist of creatives.

We have made some great partnerships and lots of growth in this area for sure. We are proud to bring in some big music profiles to Edgeware. We have been in discussions with Mahogany music, where we will hopefully be providing visuals for an immersive performance - these visuals will be able to be experienced through the digital gallery. - Youi can check out our Edgeware AMA, hosted by Shankar here discussing the project.  We also have finished our launch film which is on the site currently new-futures.co - this features alot of the work and some of the gallery concepts

We've been working through the list of creatives, and again this will be a continuous organic process throughout the year

- Content curation  

This has had a lot of work through out the last year - we have a copywriter joining the team  - and will are commissioning some more writers to input here. 



AMA mentioned above is here listen here [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49lSwhjuPLw&t=2299s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49lSwhjuPLw&t=2299s)



We found it hard to stick rigidly to milestones - as sometimes when we hit a snag or a fork in the road - and found that working on other parts of the project the best way to keep moving - and as we do that, over time, the problems have more solutions arise and we get a clearer direction to go in. Due to the site not being fully released until Q4, we felt the milestone order needed to be re-jigged a bit. Again we suggest applications with a staggered release of funding could be evaluated on a percentage basis as opposed to linear milestones. We hope this makes sense?


I hope this helps BUGZ, and apologies its a very long winded answer!

body:
Hi BUGZ,

We still have a small amount of dev work to complete for milestone one. Mainly the wallet integration to allow users to be able to mint natively on EDG. We instead have completed percentages from our second set of milestones. This fluid approach was the most logical step.

The logic to have completed the milestones in a different order was largely due to pallets to use EDG within RMRK natively, we are hoping these will be ready with a future update. We wanted to focus on what we have control over, so we tackled our second phase milestones of building out the network, gallery and artwork. The landscape is changing so quickly the options and possibilities can open up more down the line. ie Talisman now accepting EDG into their wallet, and the pallets to utilise RMRK with EDG natively. The site wont be launched until Q4 of 2022, so the pallet Integration has been decided to be one of the last sprints to finalise- as this allows more of a chance for a better integration.

We do however think that future funding applications with a staggered release of funding could be evaluated on a percentage basis as opposed to linear milestones.

Thanks for the question as its really important for us to be able to be able to talk through our process on this topic.


Thank you
